cross_fit.note: the adsb_v24 cross-fit frames, unchanged: v9 = max(cross-fit v7, floor) on clock-present rows; missing-clock rows and the LIRF fill population keep the fold / refit v9

configuration.development_scheme: Each declared seed is fitted like a committee learner (tools/run_adsb_nn.py): the seasonal fold predicts January/July 2025, the forward fold predicts November 2025, the January-November refit predicts December 2025 (written to the December leaf cache). The seeds are averaged (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py -> runs/adsb_nn/ens_nn). On each of the four months the v23 recipe is rebuilt exactly as adsb_v28_v2 rebuilt it, with the committee table replaced by (1 - a) * ens_v20_bag_q_all + a * ens_nn; a = 0 is the control and must reproduce v23's recorded development RMSE.

execution.declared_before: any development fit or score of the network
execution.smoke_test: tools/run_adsb_nn_dev.py --smoke against a provisional declaration (runs/adsb_nn/smoke_decl.json, output runs/adsb_nn/smoke_dev): the network table replaced by the committee's own, so no network reading exists; the control reproduced v23's development RMSE on all four months and every candidate equalled it within 1.8e-12 s. The export rebuild of v23 on the ranking was checked the same way (0.0 difference, integers equal the uploaded v23).

network.rationale: October design (docs/adsb_nn/design_report_1.json): 20 design fits. Piecewise-linear embeddings beat scalar rank inputs (rank -0.07% committee blend); target clipping at 5400 s, lr 5e-4, 1024x4 with dropout 0.2, dropout 0.2 + weight decay 1e-3 and a 10-epoch budget all blend worse; clipping at 21600 s, weight EMA, clip+EMA, 16-dim numeric and 32-dim categorical embeddings are within the base seed noise (single base seeds -0.73..-1.00%). Seed averaging dominates: the mean of 2/4/8 base seeds blends at -1.12/-1.25/-1.44% (committee level, best weight 0.35/0.40/0.45) and -0.50/-0.57/-0.66% on the October recipe proxy (best weight 0.40/0.45/0.50, flat between 0.45 and 0.55). TabM-mini k=4 is the best single network (167.49) but blends at -0.89% with error correlation 0.925 at ~3.2x the compute of a base seed, below two base seeds (-1.12%) - so the declared network is the base recipe with 16 fresh seeds (101-116), and the declared shares are 0.3/0.4/0.5/0.6 around the recipe optimum. The second tabm4 design seed was still running at declaration time and is reported as an addendum; it cannot change this choice.
network.rows: LIRF left out of fitting and monitoring, exactly as the committee learners; every row predicted

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

prior_evidence.closed: residual-stage tuning (v25 shipped, v26/v27 null), committee seeds and re-weighting (v18/v20), calibration, test-time adaptation, matcher fixes, blend weights (v28); none is re-tested here.
prior_evidence.committee_rounds: every committee CatBoost stopped at 9-15k rounds under its 20k cap (runs/*/seasonal|forward/run.json)
prior_evidence.design: configs/adsb_nn_design_v1.json protocol: October-only readings of networks fitted on the seasonal fit partition; no recipe month or ranking month was predicted or read. The design reports are parents of this declaration.

configuration.purpose: A neural-network member for the incumbent committee. The committee (ens_v20_bag_q_all: 9 LightGBMs at 1/4, 13 combination CatBoosts at 3/4) carries 0.7 of every non-LIRF prediction in v23; every member is a gradient-boosted tree ensemble. The network is fitted on the same 314 columns and rows and mixed into the committee table at a fixed share.
configuration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v23. This is the rule of adsb_v25/v26/v27 with the control in place of the baseline.
configuration.ship: If a candidate is selected: every declared seed is refit on January-December 2025 at the same epoch budget (tools/run_adsb_nn.py --fold refit12); the ranking network table is the seed mean; the shipped v23 ranking values are rebuilt from their recorded components (v9, residual, committee and LIRF twelve-month tables) with only the committee table replaced by the selected mix; a zero share must reproduce the uploaded v23 exactly; exported as the next version through the frozen submission contract, verified independently (every saved network reloaded and re-predicted), audited (tools/audit_export.py), and uploaded only with the user's approval. LIRF rows must equal the uploaded v23.
